g.text: Pibbl · Composable Tangram
Vivid coral + Kelly green + soft violet · Ten ways to bring the library into the mark
1. Resize handles
Interaction · the green block becomes editable.
2. Angle geometry
Geometry · a measured corner in the empty triangle.
3. Woven texture
Textures · fine diagonal threads on the green block.
4. Motion path
Animation · keyframes travel through the negative space.
5. Tiny dataviz
Visualization · a rising chart between the pieces.
6. Particle bloom
Particles · the curved bowl breaks into playful dots.
7. Layer stack
Composition · three translucent planes in the stem.
8. Bézier craft
Paths · a curve and its control handles fill the gap.
9. Spring energy
Animation + physics · a spring lives inside the stem.
10. Faceted bowl
Geometry + Three.js · a mesh within the violet curve.
